description: This is a test module for the 'weave_otel' integration in the 'litellm' project. It contains unit tests for the functions 'get_weave_otel_config' and '_set_weave_specific_attributes', verifying configuration creation with different environment variable scenarios and attribute setting behaviors in spans.

methods.name: test_get_weave_otel_config()
methods.description: Tests creation of WeaveOtelConfig with valid environment variables and missing variable scenarios.

methods.name: test_get_weave_otel_config_with_custom_host()
methods.description: Tests config creation with custom 'WANDB_HOST' environment variable, ensuring proper URL formation with or without protocol and trailing slash.

methods.name: test_set_weave_specific_attributes_display_name_from_metadata()
methods.description: Verifies that '_set_weave_specific_attributes' sets 'display_name' from the 'metadata' field if present.

methods.name: test_set_weave_specific_attributes_display_name_from_model()
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior where 'display_name' is set from 'model' when not present in 'metadata'.

methods.name: test_set_weave_specific_attributes_thread_id_and_is_turn()
methods.description: Checks that session_id from metadata is used to set 'thread_id' and 'is_turn' attributes.
